instructions: Replace config/servicenow_field_mapping.json with this file after creating u_correlation_id and u_external_observation_id, increasing u_probable_cause to at least 255 characters, and increasing u_recommended_action to 4000 characters. The inherited Task approval field is addressed by the column name approval.

Correlation ID.review_note: New String field, length 100; used as the idempotent upsert key.

External observation ID.review_note: New String field, length 100; stores values such as OBS-PAY-006.

Scenario ID.review_note: Intentionally not mapped in the lean ServiceNow demo.
